summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers with string-array indirection) and constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, downloads the Bun runtime into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bun-cjs bundle protected by a string-array rotor (`WV8StW` rotating `n7gIxM`). The package is published under a scope suggesting a PostCSS configuration helper, a purpose that has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque multi-hundred-KB binary payload. The obfuscated payload is executed under Bun specifically to bypass Node-based static tooling, and the entire chain fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
